everyone.description: Add yourself to the queue. If you are already in the queue this shows your position.
Show the first x entries of the queue. If "live" is given only live viewers will be shown. If no number is given the whole queue is shown

moderators.description: Open the Queue. And sends a message to pin in chat (Can be edited in the Dashboard).
Close the queue. Viewers can't join/leave anymore. The queue can still be rotated and players can be added/removed by mods.
Rotate the queue by x viewers. Rotate by one if no number is specified.
Remove the first x viewers from the queue. Move by one if no number is specified.
Change the number of live players. Shows current number of live players if no number is given.
